title: The proclamation of the Brazilian Republic
summary: On 15 November 1889 a group of officers of the Imperial Army under Marshal Deodoro da Fonseca deposed Pedro II and the Viscount of Ouro Preto in Rio de Janeiro without firing a shot, ending the constitutional monarchy and establishing the First Brazilian Republic; a provisional government under Deodoro was in place the same day. The Empire had lost both of the bases it stood on: the Church, after the quarrel of the 1870s, and the large landowners, who withdrew their support after the abolition of slavery eighteen months earlier had been carried without compensating them.
